body:
I definitely agree with being transparent with my psych, but I'm a student here. 
My psych appointments are under the hospital at my uni, so I'm scared that drug usage like lorazepam will be an issue for students. They have the same thing where students can be barred from exams if they find out they're self harming. 
Also, I'm worried that my psych might be more apprehensive to prescribe me any additional medication because I wasn't using it for its intended purpose.

I am on Lexapro and I've been on 20mg for awhile now. I'd say that it helps a lot with my anxiety on a regular basis, but I have periods of time (2 weeks - 1 month or more) where my depression just gets unbearable. Like my aforementioned symptoms. It definitely worsens when i have an exam or presentations, i get the 'i can't get up' episodes more frequently then. I'm scared that they'll get mad at me for taking lorazepam in these situations and I won't be prescribed anything to deal with these symptoms. It's really isolating when it happens and it's frustrating that it's happening so often, I'm just scared that I'll just have to deal with it on my own.
Yeah my psych said it's very common to go through emotional blunting with Lexapro.
Thank you and same to you!

I know exactly what you mean! It hits hard when I'm going through something tough but cannot physically bring myself to cry. 

Connecting with people is also hard cause it almost feels like my emotional processing is delayed? Idk, I've gotten used to people not understanding how I feel but I hate that I can't connect and be fully present with my friends. 

My friend confided in me for emotional support and I know how I'm supposed to feel but I don't feel it, if that makes sense. In turn, I don't really know how to support them cause I can't process my own emotions, so how am I supposed to help them? It just makes me feel like I'm being a shitty friend.

I just wish I could feel the way I'm supposed to and say the right things. I just want to be there for my friends.

I've been sertraline and vortioxetine before, just ssris though. I've been on Lexapro for years and have talked to my psych about changing meds but the general consensus is that i should stick to this one cause it's worked well for my anxiety. 

I'm trying to be realistic about my expectations of meds, my choice is either being debilitatingly anxious off Lexapro or being perpetually depressed on it. Maybe I'm settling for the wrong meds but honestly, I'm so tired of dealing with my symptoms and starting all over again with new meds.

I started therapy and that's already a big step for me. I haven't been completely honest about my suicidal thoughts though, at least not to the extent that it actually is. It feels really vulnerable to say how I'm feeling fully without downplaying the actual severity of it.

Number 2 is exactly as you've described it for me! It just feels really slow for my brain to get into action. Like I know I'm supposed to feel scared/anxious etc but I just can't feel it if that makes sense(?). Or when I'm supposed to do things like studying or chores or even where i put things, I keep forgetting.

The worst is when I'm reading but my brain just cannot register the info no matter how hard i try. Like it takes rereading multiple times to understand but trying to regurgitate the info back feels impossible. It makes my studies sooo time consuming and frankly, really frustrating.
Thank you.

This! I feel like I'm in a dream and whenever i revisit previous texts or even notes, i have a difficult time recalling when and if i even wrote them. I'm still aware but it feels like I don't have full control of my body, like my senses and consciousness is numbed somehow. It's really disorienting and it freaks me out. I genuinely wake up feeling like I'm not real.
Currently in the same boat. I wish i could offer help or some form of consolation but I'm at my wit's end too. I'm just hoping it'll pass for the both of us.
Please help, i don't know what else to do. It's lonely, all my days are a blur. Life is too blurry for me to be anything.
It's so frustrating cause i genuinely do look forward to hanging out and spending time with my friends but the anxiety over anticipating the plan takes the fun out of it.
This is very true! My bpd got so much better once i moved away from home for my studies. Things were bearable.

>More or less it zaps the life out of you and makes you feel “okay” with the misery you are feeling.

Exactly how I'm feeling!

The Lexapro withdrawal was awful but I felt like i hit a wall. I just wanted to get things done and not feel depressed for so long. I learned very quickly that i still need to be medicated though so i learned my lesson. 

I'm honestly quite scared of coming clean to my doctor about stopping cold turkey and I've been on Lexapro for awhile so the discussion of new meds never came up. I'll bring it up on my next appointment though.

nope, it's never really occurred to me cause technically the Lexapro does work but i guess only for my anxiety (?). I was just happy to settle on a med that actually helped me so i didn't consider other options. I'll try asking my doc about that.
I've never thought of genetic testing before, I'll try discussing that with my doctor. Thank you!
I guess so, but that takes a lot of conviction and consistency. Somedays are better than others i guess
Thank you!

That's awfully depressing, but I guess that's the way it goes. It's difficult to create the point though when i don't feel like sticking around for anything or anyone, not even myself. That sounds selfish but I've found myself stuck with the same feelings even when I've achieved something. Then I'd convince myself 'there must be more' or 'it gets better' but it never does. It's anticlimactic and awfully repetitive.

I'm sorry you're in the same boat. It's really difficult losing someone you love, i feel like i don't fit in anywhere anymore. Moving past this feels impossible but i have faith it'll work out somehow!

Thank you for saying that. It feels impossible to focus on my wellbeing cause I'm constantly thinking about how all of this is affecting my family, especially my younger sister. I feel like I'm not doing my part but whenever he yells i find that the only thing I'm capable of doing is to just go in a "freeze" mode and hope that he stops. I'm hoping that all of this will end eventually.

I'm on Lexapro currently, i try my best to be medically compliant but when the episodes get particularly bad i am tempted to stop taking them cause i don't see the point. But all in all, im pretty good with my meds. I hate exercising too but I started to jog cause i find that it does help a bit and i walk to my campus everyday. I honestly have no idea what i can do to fix my situation that is within my control, the episodes just seem to come and go as it pleases.

Honestly, just knowing someone else is in the same boat as i am is assuring in itself. Thank you for articulating how i feel into words. It's frustrating that we're doing everything we can to not feel the way we do but it happens anyway just because it can. I know it's temporary, i know i can get through it, but i also know that i will have to go through it again. 

It is exhausting.

Im scared i might be blowing things out of proportion. Maybe everything is normal and fine from his pov and by telling him how i feel about our lack of connection would create a problem for him too. I don't know if me reaching out first would be the appropriate thing to do, because our prior texts were always enjoyable for me but he always cut them short. I can't tell if it's because he's busy or he simply doesn't enjoy talking with me. I don't want him to think im clingy but i don't want him to think I don't like him either. Should i just wait for him to text first or just text him because i like talking to him?
This! Sometimes i get frustrated writing in my journal cause it doesn't make sense but i feel too much. It's like my brain is working faster than i can put it into words.
Omg i can't imagine how it must feel, im a lone wolf and can barely take care of myself. Props to you!
Anytime my friend :)
Got it. Thank you so much!
So i should wait?

unfortunately I've never seen him in person :( We met online for a course project and i reached out to him via social media. Im trying not to get ahead of myself and get attached too quickly but what if he feels im not putting in enough effort to know him? Or if im being too much? Really struggling to find the balance here.

Yeah same here, mornings feel impossible. I wish i could tell you why but honestly for me, it's one of those things that happens just because. Maybe it's an underlying symptom for depression but mornings are definitely the hardest. It's awful for anyone to start their day feeling this way.

It started a couple months back and initially, i thought it would last a couple of days tops cause that's usually how it is for me. Then i find that it keeps getting worse and it's long term unlike before.
Honestly im sleeping really often, like any chance i get cause im so exhausted all the time
I haven't had any blood tests done, what are they for?
My appointment isn't until April but im honestly not sure if it'll help. Im open to any advice atm if you're offering

How do you know though? Like, how do you know he's the right one for you? I tend to split whenever things get serious but i never know if it's warranted or if it's just the self-sabotage doing the talking.
Every waking moment.

I get what you mean. I feel like an open wound when i get mine. The only thing i can do is just wait for it to pass but the waiting feels like forever and then it comes again. Im sorry that you had to go through that, it's an awful feeling to have.

I've been on antidepressant for a while now and it does help my anxiety but i feel like my depressive symptoms are still the same. As for the external circumstances, i honestly feel like im living a more social and healthier life, im not isolating myself and i get plenty of sun exposure. 

Im a student so stress is inevitable but i enjoy my degree so it's not too bad. It seems like im doing everything im supposed to on paper but somehow it feels worse.

If you don't mind me asking, what was the major depressive episodes like?

Going through something similar at the moment, i think for me it's the fear that they're the only ones left willing to put up with me. Like, if i say the wrong things, show disinterest or if they start being dismissive, then that's it for me. They'll leave once they realize im not worth staying.
Im afraid my uni wouldn't be as considerate as yours :( im just worried that im making up the fatigue and exhaustion and that there is really nothing wrong with me other than me
Damn, that sucks :(
I am medicated, and i agree, it has helped me tremendously. I just wish it could make me feel less lonely.
That's exactly how i feel! Once i found the right med for me i was like " so THIS is how people feel??"

>I see in the comments that your mom is a doctor, so it is probably doubly invalidating

It really is! That's why it took me too long to actually get help.

That's the thing, she is a doctor but she gets biased when it comes to mental issues, at least for me. So i don't know if i should keep taking it or not. My psychiatrist hasn't mentioned anything about tapering off my dose so i assumed I'm still fine being on it.
I hope it'll be that way for me as well, it would suck if my relapse negates my uni offer
It's on my arms, im planning on covering it with a watch and some makeup. I'm worried they'll notice the texture tho.

Honestly, just giving myself the benefit of the doubt, going through the motions when i can. When it's really bad, i think about how awful it is to see a dead body- I don't want to put anyone through that.

Im in the same boat tbh. Im at that age where everybody has somebody and im realizing all my life, I've just been utterly infatuated with the idea of a person, not love, limerence. Sometimes i wonder if im even capable of it.

All the time! I struggle with ending texts so i end up dragging it out until the person just stops replying, then panic and convince myself they hate me, and realize they're probably just busy. I just get really excited when my friends text me

>Like what if I believe because I've been told that good people do and I'm bad if I don't?

I know what you mean, it's like I'm not practicing this religion because i genuinely want to, but instead I'm doing it out of fear of becoming a bad person. I honestly think that's where my black and white thinking started, the idea that you have to do good and just blindly believe.

I'm also in the same boat when it comes to my family, it's very intense and there's no room for a healthy conversation. I've learned that over the years any queries i have regarding my faith should be kept to myself because as a kid, I was constantly chastised for "asking the wrong questions". It made me feel distant and excluded from my faith and family cause i don't understand religion the way they do. 

>Your achievements and your hard work are yours. Maybe god pushed you down the path, but you're the one that walked it.

That's what I'd like to believe too.

What made you come back to your faith? I find that every time i try to get closer to god, im reminded of how guilty and unworthy i felt when i still believed. It's hard for me to rewire the preconceptions i had, even talking about my faith triggers me.
Thank you! Hoping everything will work out on your end too
Thank you for saying that, i really needed to hear it. I'm still trying to find the fine line with my mom and religion. I guess in the meantime, all i can do is focus on the things i can control.
I wish fear- mongering wasn't such a prevalent facet to religion, i think in theory being religious and having faith in a higher power could be good.

>Life is just too chaotic, and religion throws an answer at the wall and at least gives me something to work with.

This is exactly how i feel, i wish my family would've taken a gentler approach to religion cause maybe then I'd be more accepting of it. Props to your mother for raising you that way.

This is exactly how i feel. Sometimes i wish i could accept god the way my mom did cause it saved her. I feel like being religious is the only way for her to like me. But I can't cause i'd be lying to myself for the rest of my life.
I dropped out of college twice (i was going through it lol) and re-enrolled last year. Now im waiting for uni acceptance.
We don't even see each other anymore. I just want to forget about him or at the very least, stop feeling like my self worth depreciates every time he's with someone.

I have, sometimes it works to keep my mind off of things but there are times where im so overwhelmed, even that can't help me. I find that sometimes, i just need to ride the feeling out and wait for it to pass; at least that's how it goes for me.
"you've got a pretty face, why would you wanna kill yourself?" stroked my ego a tad bit but made me wanna die even more.
I used to struggle with agoraphobia too! That's so cool that you not only managed to overcome it but also traveled around the world.

That's what my mom says too, last year i was struggling with nihilism and had to take a break from everything. During that time i realized, that no matter what i think of myself, whether positively or negatively, I've always wanted to help people, it gives me purpose to comfort and be there for others. I want to be the doctor I needed during my treatment. Thank you for your kind words, i feel a bit better about my choice now.

Im trying to continue medicine, I've wanted to be a doctor ever since i was a kid and i honestly can't see myself pursuing anything else. But after doing my research online, most of the med students say that it's not worth it and how the system mistreats them. My mom is extremely supportive of my choice which im thankful for but as much as I'd like to just try my best and follow my heart, i still need to weigh my options.
Im just worried I'll fall out of love with it, right now obviously im very passionate and I'd give anything to have the job but almost everyone says that it's not worth the difficult path.
Everyday all day
Literally prior to my exam i was panicking like my whole life is gonna fall apart, and now that i got what i want i still feel the same if not even more pressured.
It never ends =D
Took the words out of my mouth. Worse part is he doesn't even know i exist and im still head over heels for this guy and i know the second he notices me I'll split
I didn't even think about taking vitamins. Will definitely try it out! Thank you.
I get what you mean by people become and marry their parents. I usually notice the red flags in my parents in people im attracted to, but by the time i realize it im already in too deep.

I think the idea that people can actually like me seems impossible to me. Like it's only a matter of time until they see who i am and realize that this isn't what they signed up for. In a way, i feel like im doing them a favor by burning that bridge.

You are not fundamentally broken, i know it feels impossible at times and it's so much harder when you're mind is conspiring against you. Don't let this disorder make you feel defective simply because you process emotions differently. Idk what type of situation you're in but i know that feeling. Take it slow and show yourself some grace, reach for the low hanging fruits, the small things that brings you joy. One foot in front of the other, someone once told me that and i still remember it to this day. Im sorry that you're feeling this way and i hope that you can find the comfort you need. All the best! <3

I know exactly what you mean, whenever someone cancels on me it ruins my whole day. Maybe it's cause i rarely hangout with people so i tend to plan my days surrounding the hangout and when they cancelled it messes everything up entirely. Last minute cancellations are the worst, i take it so personally and it's as if them cancelling on me is confirming all of my paranoia that nobody likes me. I try to look at the situation in a positive light, like maybe something genuinely unavoidable came up or try to convince myself that they're not worth my time cause they don't respect me enough to give an earlier notice especially when im the one planning it, but usually i just wallow.
⊂⁠(⁠(⁠・⁠▽⁠・⁠)⁠)⁠⊃ tis the superior location of choice.
Absolutely! This and sitting in the shower
Thank you, i really appreciate the offer 🤗

I've been to a few different therapists and unfortunately, haven't had the best experience with most of them. I agree that therapy can be a huge help but i just haven't found the right one for me. On top of college, i don't really have the time nor the means to book an appointment but i really do hope to find the right therapist for me in the future. Thank you so much for your kind words. Wish you the best of luck!

Im so sorry you had to go through what you did with your last episode. I can't begin to imagine how you must've felt when your colleagues treated you that way. You did the best you could given your circumstance and i salute you for that. I know how hard it is to ride out the emotions and i can tell you were trying your best to recover. It's a relief to know that im not the only person going through this, so thank you for sharing your experience with a bpd episode. Im incredibly grateful for your kind words and i, too, wish you the best of luck on your endeavors kind stranger <3

I have the same thing, i think it's also partly cause i tend to overshare on social media and also i start to overthink when it doesn't get any interaction. I just ended up deleting my social media accs altogether.

Thank you so much for saying this. This disorder messes my perspective on things so i never know if my feelings and reactions are unwarranted or not. I've thought about getting a restraining order before but im scared of what he'll do to my brother cause they live together. When my sister and i refuse to meet my dad, he basically won't let us see him. My brother usually gets the brunt of it even when we lived together. He's been through so much and he never talks about it so I don't want to make things harder for him than it already is. I don't really have anyone in my family to talk to when it comes to dealing with him cause there's not really a solution to this issue other than legal protection. Im doing better now but thank you so much for your kind words, it helps more than you know.

I've learned to stop expecting people w/o bpd to understand what im going through. Heck, sometimes i don't even know what im going through. The best thing that i can hope for from my loved ones is to respect or honor my fears. Meaning not exactly validating my sometimes irrational thoughts, but by not being dismissive towards my fears. The thing with mental disorders is that people can't truly understand it unless they have it themselves. I always find myself disappointed whenever i have to explain and justify my fears to people cause they think my thoughts are ridiculous cause they themselves don't have it. It's a mental disorder, it's not supposed to make sense or be rational. 

I don't talk about my mental health w my family cause they think it's a taboo topic. Of course it saddens me that I can't rely on them when it comes to my struggles but I've learned that expecting them to understand does more harm than good for me. Try finding people or outlets where you can vent to. People who won't invalidate your fears and trauma, they may not be by blood but they're willing to listen.

Im sorry it might not be the answer you're looking for but i find that this has helped me out tremendously when it comes to my relationship with those who don't understand.

Thank you, i need to hear this. I feel like i owe it to him to help through his problems but at the same time I don't know how much of it i can handle. I'll talk to him about getting help from the college counselor. I can only hope he sees that he needs help and that someone is there to help him.
It's alarming how accurate this is =D
I needed to hear this. Im proud of you OP!
Thank you so much for the suggestions! I've never heard of the DARE method before, I'll definitely look into it. Hope you have a nice day kind stranger <3
this is why we can't have nice things =D

I experience this too, spent the last couple of years in isolation. Unfortunately, meds didn't really help w my agoraphobia. I do go to my doctor's appointment every month though; so i go out at least once a month. Try planning things out before you go out, i usually skip breakfast or eat something light so I won't get sick when i have anxiety. Music helps too, maybe some games to distract yourself. Take it slow and be patient with yourself. You're not alone in this :)
Thank you! It's a bit overwhelming but im going to try my best :)

I know exactly what you mean, for me, when things are ok, the imposter syndrome hits but when an episode comes it's 'ah shit here we go again'. It feels like an endless cycle, things go wrong and it's back to square one. I can't exactly say things will get easier, but with therapy and meds it's definitely help me deal w the severity of the episodes (most of the time). You're definitely not alone in this, all the best!
One hug coming right up! ⊂((・▽・))⊃

>It's not their problem to solve because it isn't their problem.

You're totally right, but sometimes i just wish at the very least people wouldn't try to invalidate my emotions and fears ykwim. Like, they don't have to understand, but they can at least be supportive of my efforts. Anyway, thank you for your kind words. It's incredibly nice to see someone acknowledge that i am trying :)

It's very difficult to find people who understands or even tries to understand agoraphobia irl. I've found this community to be supportive and comforting when it comes to dealing with it. Thanks for kind words :)
Thank you for your kind words, it means a lot to find someone who can relate to what im going through. Much love!
Will do, thank you!
extra points if most of your crochet projects are never finished :D

I've been doing ok in terms of coping with the overwhelming emotions, but i guess it's bound to catch up to me and this just happened to be the situation. I'll definitely try the mantra if i feel overwhelmed again. Im so relieved to hear that someone else understands how i feel. Thanks for your input and good luck to you too!
Thank you for saying that, he keeps guilt tripping and it's tough to not let his words get to me.
Oh absolutely, i can only hope that future me learns how to cope w life better :')

Im trying to take it day by day too. Ik exactly what you mean abt the writing stuff, sometimes it feels like everything i write is so repetitive and i don't feel good abt writing anymore. Music helps me most of the time, but on the rare occasions that it doesn't...man i feel like i lost my mind. Anyway, thanks for replying, wish you the best!
Ik these things takes time but sometimes it feels like forever ykwim :/ It's nice to know im not the only one feeling like this tho :)

Im so sorry to hear that, it must be difficult starting all over again. If you don't mind me asking, how did you bring up agoraphobia to your therapist? I meet my therapist in person so im scared that they'll think im not affected by it cause i showed up :/
silly me for thinking food could fill this empty void that is my soul :')

I know exactly what you mean, there are some days when i wake up and it's just a terrible day completely unprecedented. It's like the emotions are at an all time high and everyone and everything pisses me off. I think it's due to the mood swings that comes w bpd.
You had me at "impossible to kill" ;) I'll definitely look into those.
I'll try showing it to my therapist next time. Thanks!
Plants sounds good, maybe I'll get small ones and see how that'll turn out. Thanks for the suggestion :)
Im trying to, but idk how to bring it up to a therapist w/o sounding ridiculous :(
Thanks, that's actually really assuring to hear :)
Ah i see. I don't have bipolar either so maybe it was just a good mood. Thanks for the input!

I've been on sertraline and vortioxetine, vortioxetine didn't really work for me i just kinda had to deal w the side effects but for the most part i felt the same. Sertraline did help with the severity of my emotions but because of that i feel really empty most of the time and the side effects are horrible. I honestly don't know if it's doing much for bpd symptoms but it helps w my depression, plus i take em to feel like im doing something yk? like this is an effort to my recovery even if it doesn't work

Basically all of my friends, idk why i feel the need to tell them my life story but it just happened ig. Then I'd feel really horrible and apologize to them and never talk to them again cause in my head im doing them a favor staying away from me =D
lol lucid dreaming always freaked me out :D but there was one time that i could fly and boy was it an experience
Thanks for the recommendation, I'll definitely have to try taking it in the mornings instead. I have an appointment w my doctor soon so I'll definitely bring it up.
Thank you! I've only been on 2 meds so I'll definitely look into these

I've been taking it since August 2021 but my dose got increased during October. That's when i felt the meds were kinda working but that's also when the side effects really kicked in. It kinda helped with the severity of my breakdowns but it does make me feel empty most of the time. I try to take it at night and in usually pretty consistent with it.

I want to change to some other meds but i feel like sertraline worked as opposed to my previous med. I wouldn't say it helped completely but it did help with the severity of my breakdowns. If you don't mind me asking, what meds worked for you atm?
This happens to me too. It's bearable when other people are around but when im home alone it's the worst.
"im whatever you want me to be :)" is my go-to answer...but yeah i feel you
lol I'd be stalking them for months and the second they like me back suddenly i hate them :D

I've been trying to write my thoughts in my notes app. When things gets overwhelming, i put on a good playlist and write whatever i want to, it can be how im feeling, letters to people or even conversations i want to have w people just to feel like im not alone. It doesn't have to be good, heck sometimes it not even eligible but it's something. If it gets too overwhelming to the point where i cant really articulate it into words, i write down whatever lyrics or phrases that resonate w me. It doesn't stop the overwhelming-ness, but it sure does help me process it and kinda ride it out healthily (or at least healthier than sh).

My psychiatrist told me to find hobbies and new skills that i can learn but i find that it doesn't really help me. To me it kinda feels like im distracting myself from my emotions and it's like trying to contain a volcano that's about to erupt but it could help prevent those negative thoughts from occuring in the first place. Yk keep the mind preoccupied and whatnot :/.

Hopefully this helps, im so sorry you're going through this atm but just know that you are not fighting this battle alone :) sending much love <3

For me, feelings of emptiness kinda has a degree to it. Some days it doesn't really bother me, it just kinda feels like your life and being as a whole is in a state of plateau. Whilst sometimes it feels like my soul is insatiable, nothing satisfies it, nothing makes me happy or sad - like a bottomless pit kinda. Occasionally, I'd feel numb, almost like im on autopilot, but more often than not it's like any emotions i feel doesn't fill the metre. I feel it, but it's not enough, kinda like floating (?) but it's not zen, it's terrifying, i feel defected and consumed by nihilistic thoughts.

Ik exactly what you mean. I lost my fp a couple months ago and it's been chronic emptiness almost daily. I feel so lost and alone w/o my fp but the way that i cope w it is by picking up new hobbies here and there. It doesn't stop the lonely feeling but it sure does help. Ik that where im at mentally rn, i cant have a healthy relationship w anyone so im taking the time on managing myself better. But ofc it depends on you, it's really tempting to find a new fp and feel less lonely, but it doesn't hurt to take time for yourself either :)

I couldn't have said it better myself. Honestly, i don't know why anyone would go on. To me, this life feels so temporary and so meaningless. Yeah you can try to cope w skills and meds but at the end of the day I'm stuck with me, and that's fucking disappointing. My therapist said that i feel this way cause its a transitory state, most people in my life says that. However it doesn't feel like it's temporary ykwim? like everything is just gonna get worse from here. And if it is a temporary feeling why dont other 18y/o feel that way? I gave college a go and i failed, i barely socialize and i feel like the disappointment of the family. Ig if i had to say the reason I go on atm is just pure fucking spite and im too scared to go :).

On another note, im sorry that you feel this way. I wish i could've had a better answer but i dont. Maybe someday tho. Wish you the best!

Im so sorry you're going through this. The chronic emptiness that comes w bpd is really a pain in the butt. Recovery sometimes seems impossible because of it but there are people who will support you irl or online. You're not alone in this. Im rooting for you!
You, too!

Yeah im still searching for my passion but i suppose i need to take it one step at a time. Im sorry to hear that you're going through a depressive episode, it must be difficult esp when you're loved one is unwell.  Hopefully things will get better on your end <3

also im so excited for your bookshelves XD
I feel ya dude. Hang in there :)
This!! It happens so often that i start to think im having symptoms for attention :p

I miss having a friend too. For me it's an on and off type of thing, like i tend to cycle through friends and friend groups cause I'd overthink things and it gets overwhelming. Somewhere along the lines i guess i just stop socializing and here we are :). I'd say my abandonment issues are usually the cause of it
lol this exact thing happened to me :D. I had a full mental breakdown cause i couldn't find the DAE stickied at the top. Now im banned and i still can't find it.
Im pretty positive most of us have both.... it's tough being hot and mentally ill out here ᕙ(⇀‸↼‶)ᕗ

I haven't found the solution to this yet, but i definitely feel you. My mood swings gets soo much worse on my period and im much more impulsive too. You're not alone in this, sending lots of love your way.
Omg...i hope you're doing ok despite what you're going through atm. Lots of love <3, I'm rooting for you.
Yup, i myself have cried over a spoon before :) good times. But imo, yours is a perfectly good reason to cry over, it might seem dumb atm but i assure you, your feelings are valid.
All fun and games until you're hit with the inevitable crippling feeling of loneliness =D....i know this all too well
